description: This file defines the Controller class 'Marketplace' for the 'Opencart' admin extension. It manages listing, installation, and uninstallation of marketplace extensions in the OpenCart system, including handling HTTP requests, permissions, and loading related models and controllers.

classes.name: Marketplace
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace extensions within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets output to the list of marketplace extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders the list of available and installed marketplace extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a marketplace extension, including permission checks and language loading.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a marketplace extension, again with permission checking.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the extension list view as the default action.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Builds a list of available marketplace extensions, checking installed extensions against available files, and loads the marketplace view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Processes the installation request, verifying permissions, loading extension files, and updating extension state.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Processes the uninstallation request, verifying permissions and removing the extension from installed extensions.
